title: Compound Components & Context Isolation Pattern
problemStatement:
Structuring multi-part components (Tabs, Accordions, Selects, Dialogs) that share implicit state without prop-drilling.

**Enterprise Importance**:
The compound component pattern is the foundational API structure for all enterprise UI libraries (Radix, Chakra, Material UI).
interviewTrap: Exposing a single massive component with 50 configuration props (`<Tabs tabs={[{title, content, disabled, icon}]} />`) instead of composable compound primitives.

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: Parent component exposes internal state and handlers through an isolated React Context. Sub-components consume that context and render their specialized roles with complete compositional freedom for the consumer.
stepByStepWalkthrough: 1. Design Token Layer: Primitives, semantic aliases, and component tokens established.
2. Component Architecture: Headless state and keyboard accessibility hooks implemented.
3. Styling & Cascade: Zero-runtime CSS variables and layer specificity managed.
4. Governance & Packaging: Tree-shaking, semantic versioning, and telemetry monitored.
detailedExplanation.underlyingEngineInternals:
## 🧩 Compound Components Pattern

Instead of configuring a complex component through a monolithic array of props:

### ❌ Anti-Pattern: Configuration Prop Explosion
```tsx
<Tabs
  items={items}
  defaultActiveTab={0}
  tabPosition="top"
  renderCustomTabHeader={(item) => <CustomHeader item={item} />}
  renderTabContent={(item) => <CustomBody item={item} />}
/>
```

### ✅ Production-Grade Compound Pattern
```tsx
<Tabs defaultValue="account">
  <Tabs.List aria-label="Manage account">
    <Tabs.Trigger value="account">Account</Tabs.Trigger>
    <Tabs.Trigger value="password">Password</Tabs.Trigger>
  </Tabs.List>
  <Tabs.Content value="account">
    <AccountSettingsForm />
  </Tabs.Content>
  <Tabs.Content value="password">
    <PasswordSettingsForm />
  </Tabs.Content>
</Tabs>
```

### Architecture & Implementation
1. **Isolated Context**: Create `TabsContext` scoped strictly to the parent `Tabs` instance.
2. **Compound Namespacing**: Attach sub-components as static properties (`Tabs.List`, `Tabs.Trigger`, `Tabs.Content`) or export them as named sub-modules for tree-shaking.
